name: Solo Sadhana Week, Ridgeback Yoga Farm
summary: One practitioner alone in a cabin on a strict six-session daily schedule of asana, pranayama, and sitting, silent until evening. A teacher checks in daily. Advanced. $280.
description:
A week for one experienced practitioner who wants a fixed, demanding daily schedule and solitude to do it in.

**The schedule**
Set in advance and kept. 4:30 rise. 5:00 pranayama (45 min). 6:00 asana (90 min). 8:00 breakfast. 9:00 sitting (60 min). 10:30 karma yoga on the farm (2 hrs). 13:00 lunch and rest. 16:00 asana (90 min). 18:00 sitting. 19:00 supper. 20:00 japa. 21:00 sleep. A bell from the farmhouse marks each session.

**Silence**
Until supper. At supper the teacher, Anand Rao, eats with you and you may talk: about the practice, or not. This is the daily check-in. Otherwise no contact.

**Demand**
High. Six practice sessions and two hours of farm work daily, starting at 4:30, for seven days.

**Level**
Practitioners with at least five years of daily asana and pranayama. Anand will ask about your practice by phone before confirming and will decline if it is not a fit.

**Cost**
$280 including cabin and meals.
practical: Sunday to Sunday, spring and autumn. $280. One guest. Cabin with mat space, bed, shrine shelf, outhouse, wash basin. Two sattvic meals plus breakfast. Bring your own props, practice clothes, work gloves. Nearest airport Atlanta, 2 hrs; pick-up from the bus in Dahlonega. No signal.
